## Problem

ChatGPT.app codex (single long-lived process, PID 11153 this boot) launches a fresh MCP server stack (uvx serena start-mcp-server --context codex + pyright-langserver + node + headroom mcp wrapper) per conversation epoch and leaves prior stacks running when conversations end. Because codex stays alive, stale stacks keep a live parent (never PPID 1) and evade the mem-sentinel PPID-1 orphan sweeper shipped for centauric-gnomic-hake (7495-36ea-df75-4a3d) — the surviving variant of that defect class. Stale stacks (~1.2GB each; 4 epochs Sep 6/7/9/10 observed) go fully swapped-out and stop draining FSEventStreams while remaining registered clients; under rebar's fs-event volume fseventsd accretes buffers without bound and never returns memory (peak==current): 107GB phys_footprint by day 4 of the Sep 6 boot (27.2GB RSS + 79.8GB swapped, 136.8M live mallocs, 47.8M path strings), swap 67/68.6GB — near-recurrence of incident 2ab6-bae5-8ca4-429c. Claude/Copilot ide-assistant serena instances do not accumulate.

## Approach (remediation executed 2026-09-10, operator-assisted)

1. 4-phase debug confirmed mechanism (hypothesis tests: codex-code-mode-host VSZ = reserved address space, refuted; killing one stale serena freed only its own swap while fseventsd stayed at 107GB peak==current, so reclaim requires daemon restart).
2. Stale Sep 6/7 stacks killed by explicit pid; codex observed respawning MCP servers on demand (09:57:12), so kills are safe for live conversations.
3. Serena disabled for codex in ~/.codex/config.toml (enabled=false, incident annotation); effective at next ChatGPT.app restart since codex respawns from launch-time config.
4. Operator restarted fseventsd via sudo kill (SIP blocks launchctl kickstart; launchd respawns).
5. Monitoring already in place: mem-sentinel logs fseventsdKB every 5 min and reaps PPID-1 orphans; the codex-alive-parent gap is mooted by (3).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] [non-codebase] Serena is disabled for codex: `grep -B1 -A1 'enabled = false' ~/.codex/config.toml` shows the annotated [mcp_servers.serena] block with `enabled = false`.
  provenance: environment=macos-dev-host(Joes-MacBook-Pro); principal=copilot-cli-agent(joeoakhart); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — grep of the live ~/.codex/config.toml on the incident host at close time.
- [x] [non-codebase] No stale codex serena stacks remain: `ps axo pid,ppid,lstart,args | grep 'serena start-mcp-server' | grep -v grep` shows only current-session instances (each parent uv/codex chain alive and serving a live conversation or agent).
  provenance: environment=macos-dev-host(Joes-MacBook-Pro); principal=copilot-cli-agent(joeoakhart); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — live ps enumeration on the incident host at close time; parent-chain liveness confirmed per pid.
- [x] [non-codebase] fseventsd reclaimed without reboot: `ps -o rss= -p $(pgrep -x fseventsd)` reports < 100MB RSS on a freshly respawned pid.
  provenance: environment=macos-dev-host(Joes-MacBook-Pro); principal=human-operator(joeoakhart, sudo) for the restart, copilot-cli-agent for verification; privilege_posture=broader; instrument=live-call — sudo kill of the live daemon 2026-09-10 ~09:57, RSS verified via ps on the fresh pid at close time.
- [x] [non-codebase] Swap pressure relieved: `sysctl -n vm.swapusage` shows used well below the 67GB incident level (observed 18.4GB post-remediation).
  provenance: environment=macos-dev-host(Joes-MacBook-Pro); principal=copilot-cli-agent(joeoakhart); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — sysctl vm.swapusage on the incident host at close time.
- [x] [non-codebase] Evidence trail durable: findings recorded as comments here and on 2ab6-bae5-8ca4-429c, with raw evidence under .rebar/scratch/memleak-copilot-87759/.
  provenance: environment=rebar-tickets-store(origin/tickets) + worktree scratch; principal=copilot-cli-agent(joeoakhart) via local rebar CLI; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — comment/link writes acknowledged by the CLI with ticket ids; scratch files listed on disk.

## Testing / Verification

All ACs verified live on the host 2026-09-10 ~09:58 (evidence in comments): fseventsd 107GB -> 10.9MB RSS (new PID 21316), swap used 67GB -> 18.4GB and draining, free RAM ~0.1GB -> ~52GB, compressor 65GB -> 39GB. Ongoing observation is operational via `tail ~/Library/Logs/mem-sentinel.log` (fseventsdKB column), deliberately not a ticket-held wait. No repo code changed; host-config change is ~/.codex/config.toml only, hence no file_impact recorded.


## Close-time re-verification (2026-09-10 ~10:15)

All ACs re-verified live immediately before close: annotated `enabled = false` present in ~/.codex/config.toml; 5 serena instances all live-parented (copilot, claude daemon, codex on-demand epochs); fseventsd RSS 13.2MB on fresh pid; swap used 18.4GB of 19.4GB provisioned (down from 67/68.6GB); evidence comments on this ticket and 2ab6-bae5-8ca4-429c plus .rebar/scratch/memleak-copilot-87759/. AC evidence is host state (non-codebase): no repo files changed.
